name: Ardiden Limited
summary: Ardiden Limited engages in the exploration of mineral properties in Australia and Canada. It explores for gold and lithium properties. It holds 100% interests in the Seymour Lake Lithium Project and the Pickle Lake Gold Project located in Ontario, Canada. The company was formerly known as Stratos Resources Limited and changed its name to Ardiden Limited in December 2014. Ardiden Limited is based in West Perth, Australia.
